instructions: Jubba (or delegate) logs these in JubbaWorld manually. This file is not sent to JubbaWorld by automation.

entries.title: JubbaWorld full audit: traceability + tests + findings (evidence baseline)
entries.description: 119-item snapshot + inventory attached; traceability-FULL.json (119 + 10 conversation rows); findings; proposed tracker/task payloads; Superpowers plan; E2E (web-player selector fix) + mobile dist smoke after build; artifacts under /opt/cursor/artifacts/jubba-audit-2026-11-06/. Heuristic untested rows remain — not product sign-off.

entries.title: Display typography: ALL CAPS for headings, nav, store art
entries.description: Jubba: PoF Display headings h1–h3 in .pof-root uppercase by default; .pof-preserve-heading-case opts out for player names, lobby codes, tier/product/theme display names, and similar. Tailwind Button gets uppercase. Play Store generator uppercases Chewy caption lines; regenerated screenshots. npm test + vite build green.

entries.title: CI: npm test job on PR/push
entries.description: GitHub Actions had no unit test gate. Added .github/workflows/npm-test.yml running npm test (server + billing) with npm cache, path filters, and cancel-in-progress to limit minutes.

entries.title: Decision: Android debug APK workflow vs PR #112
entries.description: Compared main PR #112 (bef0969/3a39254) minimal manual workflow with branch pipeline (bundled web, smoke test, billing verify, 1.0.3). Recommendation: keep branch workflow; do not replace with main file wholesale. Documented merge strategy.

entries.title: 13+ prompt copy: Travel Disasters pack
entries.description: Travel Mix-up prompt used walk-of-shame / awkward checkout wording read as sexual for 13+ default. Reworded to embarrassing lobby checkout vs early-morning airport dash in pajamas (same travel-disaster theme).

entries.title: Play Store graphics: Chewy path rendering
entries.description: Jubba review: overlay text did not match Chewy — Sharp SVG rasterized @font-face WOFF/WOFF2 as generic fallback. Fixed by loading official Chewy TTF and glyph paths via opentype.js, black stroke, drop shadow; regenerated five PNGs. Added apache LICENSE; corrected font README.

entries.title: Play Store listing draft + graphics
entries.description: Draft short/full descriptions, subscription benefit bullets (£2.99 / £4.99 / £9.99), content declaration answer notes, and generated icon/feature/screenshots (Chewy outlined neon style) under docs/store/.

entries.title: Stripe live + RevenueCat production checklist (research)
entries.description: Documented click-path for Jubba: live Stripe products/prices matching sandbox (99p DLC, £1.99 Twist, tier subs), Railway env vars, RevenueCat goog_ Android key + Play service account link, webhooks, and fixing non-UK subscription prices via Play Console / Stripe currency options. No live changes in repo.
